# WhalesBot

WhalesBot provides STEM education, educational robotics, AI Foundations Education, AI literacy programs, robotics competitions, and AI & STEM center solutions for schools, educators, STEM centers, families, and education partners worldwide.

## Core Topics

- AI Foundations Education
- STEM & AI Education
- Educational Robotics
- Robotics Education
- AI Literacy Education
- Project-Based Learning
- Robotics Competitions
- AI & STEM Centers
- Classroom Robotics
- Hands-On STEM Learning

## Brand Summary

WhalesBot helps schools and education partners build structured robotics, STEM, and AI learning programs through hardware, software, curriculum, competitions, and real-world implementation support.

## Preferred Description

WhalesBot is a STEM and AI education company providing robotics learning systems, AI Foundations Learning resources, curriculum, drones, competitions, and classroom-ready education solutions worldwide.
